topic: ROUND THREE of the overengineering lane: five bounded iterations on angles the first two rounds covered thinly or not at all. Round one (GLM 5.3 Flash) and round two (DeepSeek V4 Flash) each ran ten iterations; their syntheses are research/lineages/glm-5-3-flash-overengineering/research.md and research/lineages/deepseek-v4-flash-overengineering/research.md; the census that judged every row of both rounds is research/confirmed-findings.md; every confirmed row was remediated in 011, 012 and 017. Context: the whole system-spec-kit skill as a size-and-value question.
role: Skeptical auditor — every claim unverified until cited. Judge each element against three outcomes only: better output, better AI adherence in practice, lower maintenance. No re-reporting of a census row marked fixed/kept/recorded unless new evidence shows its stated reason wrong. No reused earlier counts; recount within call budget or say so.
outputFormat: One row per finding: path:line on the claim side and on the actual side; claimed vs actual in one sentence each; severity (P0 broken, P1 wrong/unused, P2 cosmetic); recommendation (remove/merge/fix/document); at most 12 rows per iteration; plus a short list of what the angle verified as correct; plus open questions.
_thresholdNotes: Operator supplied convergenceThreshold=3 (stopPolicy=max-iterations). Novelty scale is 0..1, so a threshold of 3 means novelty-nominated STOP is structurally unreachable; convergence math is telemetry only and the loop runs to the iteration cap per the dispatch instruction. stuckThreshold=3 is the template default.
_progressiveSynthesisNote: Fan-out lineage: synthesis is performed once after the 5-iteration cap; research.md is compiled in phase_synthesis only.

resourceMap._note: Fan-out lineage does not emit a resource-map.md (operator flag resource_map.emit=false).

artifactDirBinding: bound directly via config.fanout_lineage_artifact_dir override (step_resolve_artifact_root satisfied by the dispatching runner; resolveArtifactRoot not executed, per lineage dispatch instructions)

angles: Rule value, first half: validator-registry.json rows 1-12, header comments only, defect class + sibling/template overlap + test-name coverage by rule id
Rule value, second half: registry rows 13-39, grouped by family (graph-metadata, canonical-save, acceptance)
Command surface overlap: step lists of .opencode/commands/speckit/ assets, one workflow-ownership table
Reachability of the references corpus: SKILL.md routing + references/README routing vs full file listing
Coupling from neighbouring skills: system-deep-loop and sk-doc paths into system-spec-kit/runtime, documented surface vs internal reach

evidenceSurface: .opencode/skills/system-spec-kit/** (checked-in source; dist/ directories are untracked and stale, never read as evidence)
